_doc: P0 alignment of every reference to our panel frame (brief section 5). Produced by bake/src/p0/{align,g20,build_refs}.py. Per image -> sections (mode panels) -> dials: fitted photo ellipse, A_photo_to_panel (2x3, photo px -> panel px), residual (rms of the bezel ridge points about the ellipse, in PANEL px), quality, light, needle angle; per section: roll, exposure fit, outputs (rect crop bases).
mapping_rule: dial-to-dial: the photo dial's bezel OUTER edge (half-max outside the bright ridge) -> our R; the bezel ridge therefore lands at ridge_radius_in_R (~0.99 R). Camera roll from the line through both dial centres (else the inner-disc floor edge, else 0). Perspective handled per dial by the ellipse->circle affine; the window (C5) / PANEL uses the mean of both dials' affines centred on the dial-pair midpoint.
quality_rule: good: rms <= 1.5 panel px, inliers in >= 7 of 8 octants, >= 150 rays; ok: rms <= 2.5, >= 5 octants, >= 40 rays; poor: otherwise; partial: close-up fitted on an arc / an inner feature (scale rests on an assumption, see visual_check).

naming.image stem: reference file name without extension (e.g. 17_physical-cluster_full); 'ours_bench' for reference/ours/ref_comfort_bench_1920x720.png
naming.mode: comfort | sport | eco (6WB mode panel of the image) | g20 (photos of the G20 panel, already in panel frame)
naming.cluster: C1 speedo, C2 tacho, C3 fuel mini, C4 oil mini (box = centre +- 1.08 R, clipped to the panel); C5 window (box x 680-1240, y 39-708); PANEL full 1920x720. C6 (bottom arcs) lives inside the C1/C2 crops, the info bar inside C5.

suffixes..png: RGB, rectified into panel px at 1x and exposure-normalised (see the section's exposure); pixels outside the photo are 0
suffixes..raw.png: same geometry, NOT exposure-normalised (6WB images only)
suffixes..mask.png: L8: 255 = usable, 0 = any mask bit set
suffixes..maskbits.png: L8 bit field: 1 outside the photo, 2 glare, 4 watermark / UI chrome, 8 occlusion (needle + its shadow corridor, wheel), 16 live text (numerals, captions; approximate)
suffixes..json: sidecar: image, mode, cluster, box [x, y, w, h] in panel px, A_photo_to_panel (2x3) or H_panel_to_photo (3x3), exposure, quality
suffixes.@<k>x: close-ups only (13, 15, 17 C3): k x supersampled crop of the photo footprint; pixel (i, j) = panel (box.x + (i+0.5)/k, box.y + (j+0.5)/k)

naming.frame: Every crop pixel (i, j) is panel (box.x + i + 0.5, box.y + j + 0.5). Dial frame: (u, v) R units = ((x - cx)/R, (y - cy)/R), y down; angles cw12 = degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock.

masks.glare: auto: saturated blobs thicker than 2.5% of the dial radius (+ hand polygons in seeds.json)
masks.watermark: hand polygons in seeds.json (KIES logo in 04/05/06, BIMMERSTOP, the '<' button and carousel dots in 03)
masks.occlusion: needle corridor: from -0.42 R (tail) to 1.0 R, 0.12 R wide, at needle_cw12_deg (auto: red-ness ray for Comfort, overrides.json for Sport/Eco)
masks.text: auto: small bright top-hat blobs centred in 0.18-0.80 R (numerals, captions, READY/OFF, P) - approximate; bottom-arc labels are included, arc ticks beyond 0.80 R are not

rpm_minor_tick_pitch_deg.note: median spacing of minor ticks at 0.875 R

rpm_major_ticks_cw12_05.theme: RPM_START 250.5 + 32.1 k -> 282.6 .. 115.2: 6WB (05) sits ~1.3 deg earlier (roll uncertainty ~1 deg)

measurements.floor_edge_dy_R: inner-disc floor edge below the centre: 17 C1 0.242, 17 C2 0.245, 05 0.257, 07 0.221/0.260, 03 0.254 (theme 0.26)
